operator_constraints.note: Loki rejects topk over a bare log selector with a 400 parse error, and so does the proxy; the stock Grafana Explore additionally derives a log-volume query from the same expression, which Loki rejects too. Grafana throws that second rejection as an uncaught object. Nothing here is a proxy defect and no API workaround is applied.
